claim_limit: Tiny original random fixture checks reusable product correctness at one common optimizer state. It does not test training quality, convergence, performance, memory savings, GPU or trajectory equivalence. Existing six H1 cost/quality failures remain unchanged.
negative_state_error: AdamW second moment must be nonnegative

scope.forward: actual model.forward calls made by forward_fn(model); callback operations outside model stay exact
scope.loss: loss_fn(outputs), outside SaveScope hooks; re-entry into audited modules rejected
scope.selection: actual module classes; innermost forward scope wins
scope.protected: registered parameter and buffer backing-storage aliases

optimizer.initial_state: captured caller AdamW state for every arm
optimizer.execution: independent parameter and gradient clones; model is never stepped

snapshot.state_policy: missing/empty is lazy; initialized step/exp_avg/exp_avg_sq copied separately per arm
snapshot.alias_check_scope: trainable parameters, supplied registered protected tensors, existing Parameter gradients and all state tensors

independent_reference.meaning: Captured common m/v/counter; native cloned next step checked with independent input-scale moment bounds and four-corner parameter interval. Engineering controls, not scientific fidelity thresholds.

rounding_bound.parameter_interval: four m/v corners plus float32 update rounding padding

inventory.meaning: Logical saves count duplicates; excludes loss and unrelated live tensors. Not peak allocation or training memory.

limitations: Eager CPU float32, first-order, single-threaded diagnostic only; compile, checkpoint and distributed execution unsupported.
Caller-installed saved_tensors_hooks are unsupported; loss and callback postprocessing are outside SaveScope hooks only.
Registered values/storage, modes, existing grad objects and global CPU/Python/NumPy RNG restored; arbitrary callback state and external inputs are not restored.
Call between steps without an external live autograd graph. Arbitrary callback mutations and external input state are unsupported.
One common-state AdamW step is not a training-quality or trajectory-equivalence result; scientific error is reported without a success threshold.
Int8 changes backward operands; repeated module calls and repeated unpacks are counted, not assumed to occur once.
Logical payload counts are not peak memory, speed, end-to-end savings, scale or architecture claims.
Caller AdamW must have one supported group covering exactly the trainable model parameters. Callback/concurrent optimizer mutations are rejected, not restored.
